dedupe_keys.name: a cooperative drl approach for autonomous traffic prioritization in mixed vehicles scenarios

description: The source describes cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning for unsignalised intersections with ordinary vehicles, connected vehicles and priority vehicles such as ambulances or police cars. Each automated vehicle acts under partial observation to give way, avoid collisions and reduce crossing time. SUMO tests use randomly generated traffic. This is simulation evidence, without a named deployed intersection or operational emergency-response performance guarantee. Public access and the deposit document licence do not establish executable access, software reuse rights or operating costs. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results.
